description: Evict a cached result from a crabcrop server. The path is the cached URL's remainder after its signature (operations and source; a preset URL works as-is, the server expands it, and the exp: segments it opens with are dropped, since the cache key does not carry them). Requires the signing secret (argument or CRABCROP_SECRET). With expires, the purge URL carries that expiry and stops working at that second, which a server with CRABCROP_PURGE_REQUIRE_EXPIRY requires. Returns how many entries were removed. For safety the request only goes to /purge/ under the configured CRABCROP_BASE (a base argument must equal it) and paths with dot segments are refused: this tool will not POST to arbitrary endpoints.

base.description: Redundant: the request always goes to CRABCROP_BASE, and a base argument must equal it (trailing slashes aside). Omit it.

expires.description: Optional unix-seconds expiry for the purge URL, emitted as an exp: segment after the signature: the signature covers it, and the server refuses the purge from that second on.

path.description: Remainder of the cached URL, e.g. "300x200/https://example.com/a.jpg".

secret.description: Signing secret. Defaults to CRABCROP_SECRET. Sensitive, deprecated: prefer the CRABCROP_SECRET environment variable; a per-call secret is kept in client transcripts.

name: purge_result
